_style_prefix: Korean webtoon (manhwa) style, high-contrast dramatic digital painting with crisp clean line art and soft cel-shading, cinematic lighting, very deep blacks, warm ochre and terracotta Sahelian palette with indigo shadows and glowing gold-ink accents (#F2C14E), dynamic camera angles, vertical webtoon composition. African and Arab setting, realistic proportions, expressive faces. No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no logo.
_negative: Avoid: any text or letters, speech bubbles, chibi/cartoon proportions, photorealistic photography look, western superhero comic style, extra fingers, deformed hands, mismatched eyes, changing the character's hairstyle/scarf/scar/glasses, white-washed or lightened skin tones, generic fantasy elf/medieval European armor.

_shots.VID: mostly empty panel with lots of negative space

ID.name: Idriss Keïta
ID.core: Idriss Keïta, 24-year-old West African man, lean tall build (176 cm), warm deep brown skin, oval face with high cheekbones, thin straight nose, tired dark eyes, a small crescent-shaped scar on his LEFT eyebrow, short tight black curly hair

acc.scarf: a faded indigo scarf (#2B3A7A) always tied around his neck with one end floating
acc.cowrie: a leather cord necklace with a single white cowrie shell

NO.name: Nour Keïta

MA.name: Mariam Keïta

outfits.A: wearing a faded wax-print dress under her shawl

BI.name: Yaye Binta
BI.base: Yaye Binta, 79-year-old West African grandmother and griot, tiny and fragile, white hair under an indigo-and-white headwrap, many small gold earrings, deeply wrinkled warm smile, a bogolan mud-cloth shawl, carrying a traditional 21-string kora with a calabash body

outfits.A: wearing a long faded indigo dress

MOU.name: Moussa Keïta

outfits.young: as a 38-year-old with a black beard, fit, laughing

SF.name: Safiya Aït-Mansour

YA.name: Yaw Mensah
